fields.statement: At 5751b870 I ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/web/... (ok) and -run Roadmap -v: TestRoadmapPageMatchesTheOperation and TestRoadmapPageEmptyAndNoAPI PASS; go vet and gofmt clean. The test builds a fixture with two milestones (Alpha, Beta) and a backlog through the api ops, checks the roadmap operation returns milestone, milestone, backlog, then GETs /roadmap and asserts the milestone titles and change set titles appear in the operation's order, each change set's href=/cs/<id> and its rz-pill--<state>, the live data-rz-fragment=/fragments/roadmap section, and that the fragment re-renders with a newly planned change set. I read the diff: internal/web/roadmap.go reads /api/roadmap?all=true through the read-only API and registers the fragment on change events. The page shows no short ID, which the owner-surfaces-no-ids constraint requires over the statement's wording; the test asserts no ID or handle is shown.
